messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: METERING.SERVICE token-count drift detected (shard=us-west-2, window=2026-03-17T09:00-09:10Z). Severity P2. Auto-suppression=false. Link: https://metrics.redwood-inference/internal/incidents/6791230000
maya: ack, oncall here. Seeing overage flags for ~120 customers in prod.
samir: which pipeline? emitter or aggregator?
maya: initial looks show emitter spikes + delayed rollup. emitter rates up ~3x for a 60s window then consumers backpressure.
anya: I'm pulling the last 30m counts from delta-store now. will paste quick query
anya: ```sql
SELECT shard, minute, tokens_emitted, tokens_aggregated
FROM meter_delta
WHERE shard = 'us-west-2'
  AND minute >= '2026-03-17T08:40:00Z'
ORDER BY minute DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
anya: results: most recent rows show tokens_emitted >> tokens_aggregated (emitted 4.2M, aggregated 1.1M) for a 2-min span.
maya: billing-ops, heads-up: customer-facing overage alerts are firing because aggregator lag leaves shadow counts. we should consider temporary suppression for signals until rollup catches up.
billing-ops: +1. We can toggle alert suppression for the next 30m but need SRE signoff. What's the rollback plan?
infra-ryan: suppression ok, but don't change ledger. Plan: 1) suppress overage notifications 2) pause emitter retries (blackhole policy) 3) kick off rollup backfill for missing minutes 4) monitor reconciled counts match emitted totals.
samir: command to pause emitter retries: `./ctl emitter pause --shard us-west-2 --reason "mitigation: backpressure"`
maya: doing step 1 now: toggling alerting rule `billing.overage.notify` -> disabled (scope: us-west-2).
maya: step 2: invoking pause cmd (samir's command). patching in 5s...
maya: ✅ emitter retries paused.
anya: started backfill job: `backfill-run --from 2026-03-17T08:40 --to 2026-03-17T09:10 --shard us-west-2` (job id bf-6791230000). ETA ~8-12m.
support-liz: prepping a proactive note for affected customers: short, honest, and mention ongoing reconciliation. Draft: "We're seeing delayed usage reporting for some requests in US-West. No billing changes will be applied while we reconcile; we'll follow up with corrected invoices if needed." Want review?
billing-ops: good. add expected ETA for reconciliation + link to status page.
maya: adding to status page: https://status.redwood-inference/incidents/6791230000 (updating).
infra-ryan: monitoring: consumer lag metric dropping from 120s -> 30s since pause. backfill progress 15% -> 40% in 3m.
anya: pasted sample discrepancy for an account: { "acct": "acme-42", "emitted": 124500, "aggregated": 32100, "window": "2026-03-17T08:56" }
samir: likely cause: brief emitter retry storm + consumer GC spikes -> duplicate emit tokens not deduped at aggregator window boundary. plan: dedupe fix will be a follow-up change.
maya: mitigation complete for now. keeping suppression for 30m, backfill running, customer comms drafted. escalate to postmortem if dedupe root cause confirmed.
billing-ops: will hold off invoice generation for affected customers till reconciliation complete.
support-liz: sending out draft to customers now (Bcc list). will include link to status and promise to follow up with reconciled numbers.
incident-bot: Incident note: mode=live-mitigation, mitigation_steps=[suppress_alerts,pause-emitter,backfill], runbook_ref=https://wiki.redwood-inference/ops/metering-backfill. thread closed for further updates after backfill completion.
